scope: Opt-in private PCH for six widget implementation files; original engine archive and compiler settings retained

conditions.features: native 2D with scripting, physics, audio, image and TTF enabled

scope.warm: one real widget source edit through Hex executable link
scope.cold: six widget objects and private PCH if present; common engine PCH, other engine objects and dependencies already built
scope.private: private preamble comment edit through Hex link
scope.public: public widgets API header comment edit through Hex link; declarations unchanged

cold_engine_sanity.scope: one paired sanity run of cold kin_engine objects/PCH/archive and Hex link; foundation, scripting, audio, physics, shaders and external dependencies already built

validation.gcc15: real private PCH and all six widget objects built; compiler flag and scope contract passed
validation.archive: all six widget object members occur once in libkin_engine.a

limitations: One host and Clang toolchain for performance; background load and CPU frequency vary.
Pilot source-to-object timings exclude archive/executable linking.
Integrated rebuilds include engine archive and Hex executable linking.
Cold widget samples retain the common engine PCH and all non-widget objects and dependencies.
Header samples add comments, not API/ABI declaration changes.
Cold-engine sanity is one pair, not a repeated full clean project/dependency benchmark.
Maximum RSS is the largest child process, not aggregate concurrent memory.
An earlier incomplete sample batch failed from transient disk exhaustion and is excluded; inputs were restored and old generated scratch artifacts removed before the measured rerun.
Published reproducer adds input/output guards and restores the starting option; timed operations match the measured script.
